newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair says he will keep EMU option open.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair says he will keep EMU option open.

text.p: Opposition leader Tony Blair said on Thursday that he was keeping his options open on joining a single European currency.
"We have to keep the the option open, otherwise we are excluded from the negotiations," he told BBC radio. "But it is unlikely that we will be in the first wave."
Blair, favoured by the latest opinion polls to win the May 1 election, was speaking ahead of the publication of the party's 10-point manifesto, which will be launched at 0930 GMT.
"If there is any question of a proposal to join a single currency in the next parliament then there will be a referendum with the British people," he said.
"There is triple lock on us entering a single currency. The cabinet must agree, parliament must agree and the people must agree in a referendum."
